name: Plan picker
summary: Three plans as cards you select, with a monthly or yearly switch that changes the prices and one plan marked as the common choice.
use: on a pricing or upgrade page
a11y: Native radio groups for the period and the plan; the whole card is the label, and the focus ring goes around the card.

use_when: an upgrade step inside a product, where the person picks a plan before going to checkout
avoid_when: more than three plans, or a feature-by-feature comparison grid: the layout holds three cards side by side
paying for the plan once chosen: use order-summary
turning single add-ons on or off: use settings-toggles

parts.name: period
parts.what: one billing period choice, Monthly or Yearly, with an optional saving note

parts.name: plans
parts.what: one plan as a selectable card: radio, name, price, who it is for and features

parts.name: tag
parts.what: a note on the plan most people choose

parts.name: price
parts.what: the price for the chosen period, its unit, and the yearly total

parts.name: for
parts.what: one line on who the plan suits

parts.name: features
parts.what: one included feature, after a check

empty.how: the Smart UI renderer puts one plain 'Nothing to show yet.' line in an empty list

loading.how: the Smart UI renderer draws each marked slot as a quiet block of its size while the data arrives; the static file shows the filled part

error.how: if prices cannot load, put an alert-banners line with a retry above the cards

disabled.how: for the plan the person is already on, set disabled on its radio, dim the card and add a 'Current plan' tag

overflow.how: three cards sit side by side in a wide box and stack in one column below that, with their rows lined up across cards

long_text.how: plan names and features wrap, the name leaves room for the radio, and the tag and period labels never wrap

keyboard: Tab moves to the billing period group, then to the plan group
Left and Right or Up and Down arrows move between Monthly and Yearly, and the prices change at once
Arrow keys move between the plan cards and select the one reached
